input: بسمی النّاطق فی ملکوت البیان
output: In My Name, calling aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance

input: حمد و ثنا سلطان مبین را لایق و سزاست که سجن متین را بحضور حضرت علیّ قبل اکبر و حضرت امین مزیّن فرمود و بانوار ایقان و استقامت و اطمینان مزیّن داشت.
output: Praise and thanksgiving beseem the Lord of manifest dominion Who hath adorned the mighty prison with the presence of their honors 'Alí-Akbar and Amín, and hath illumined it with the light of certitude, constancy and assurance.

input: علیهما بهآء الله و بهآء من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
output: The glory of God and the glory of all that are in the heavens and on the earth be upon them.

input: النّور و البهآء و التّکبیر و الثّنآء علی ایادی امره الّذین بهم اشرق نور الاصطبار و ثبت حکم الاختیار لله المقتدر العزیز المختار و بهم ماج بحر العطآء و هاج عرف عنایة الله مولی الوری.
output: Light and glory, greeting and praise be upon the Hands of His Cause, through whom the light of fortitude hath shone forth and the truth hath been established that the authority to choose rests with God, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Unconstrained, through whom the ocean of bounty hath surged and the fragrance of the gracious favors of God, the Lord of mankind, hath been diffused.

input: نسأله تعالی ان یحفظهم بجنوده و یحرسهم بسلطانه و ینصرهم بقدرته الّتی غلبت الأشیآء.
output: We beseech Him—exalted is He—to shield them through the power of His hosts, to protect them through the potency of His dominion and to aid them through His indomitable strength which prevaileth over all created things.

input: الملک لله فاطر السّمآء و مالک ملکوت الأسمآء.
output: Sovereignty is God's, the Creator of the heavens and the Lord of the Kingdom of Names.

input: نبأ عظیم میفرماید ای اصحاب ایران.
output: The Great Announcement proclaimeth: O people of Persia.

input: شما مشارق رحمت و مطالع شفقت و محبّت بوده‌اید.
output: In former times ye have been the symbols of mercy and the embodiments of affection and kindliness.

input: و آفاق وجود بنور خرد و دانش شما منوّر و مزیّن بوده.
output: The regions of the world were illumined and embellished by the brightness of the light of your knowledge and by the blaze of your erudition.

input: آیا چه شد که بدست خود بر هلاکت خود و دوستان خود قیام کردید.
output: How is it that you have arisen to destroy yourselves and your friends with your own hands.

input: یا افنانی.
output: O Afnán, O thou that hast branched from Mine ancient Stock.

input: علیک بهائی و عنایتی.
output: My glory and My loving-kindness rest upon thee.

input: خیمهٴ امر الهی عظیم است.
output: How vast is the tabernacle of the Cause of God.

input: جمیع احزاب عالم را فراگرفته و خواهد گرفت.
output: It hath overshadowed all the peoples and kindreds of the earth, and will, ere long, gather together the whole of mankind beneath its shelter.

input: روز روز شماست.
output: Thy day of service is now come.

input: و هزار لوح گواه شما بر نصرت امر قیام نمائید.
output: Countless Tablets bear the testimony of the bounties vouchsafed unto thee.

input: و بجنود بیان بتسخیر افئده و قلوب اهل عالم مشغول شوید.
output: Arise for the triumph of My Cause, and, through the power of thine utterance, subdue the hearts of men.

input: باید از شما ظاهر شود آنچه که سبب آسایش و راحت بیچارگان روزگار است.
output: Thou must show forth that which will ensure the peace and the well-being of the miserable and the downtrodden.

input: کمر همّت را محکم نمائید شاید بندگان از اسیری فارغ شوند و بآزادی رسند.
output: Gird up the loins of thine endeavor, that perchance thou mayest release the captive from his chains, and enable him to attain unto true liberty.

input: امروز نالهٴ عدل بلند و حنین انصاف مرتفع.
output: Justice is, in this day, bewailing its plight, and Equity groaneth beneath the yoke of oppression.

input: دود تیرهٴ ستم عالم و امم را احاطه نموده.
output: The thick clouds of tyranny have darkened the face of the earth, and enveloped its peoples.

input: از حرکت قلم اعلی روح جدید معانی بامر آمر حقیقی در اجساد الفاظ دمیده شد.
output: Through the movement of Our Pen of glory We have, at the bidding of the omnipotent Ordainer, breathed a new life into every human frame, and instilled into every word a fresh potency.

input: و آثارش در جمیع اشیای عالم ظاهر و هویدا.
output: All created things proclaim the evidences of this worldwide regeneration.

input: اینست بشارت اعظم که از قلم مظلوم جاری شده.
output: This is the most great, the most joyful tidings imparted by the Pen of this Wronged One to mankind.

input: بگو ای دوستان ترس از برای چه.
output: Wherefore fear ye, O My well-beloved ones.

input: و بیم از که.
output: Who is it that can dismay you.

input: گلپار‌ه‌های عالم باندک رطوبتی متلاشی شده و میشوند.
output: A touch of moisture sufficeth to dissolve the hardened clay out of which this perverse generation is molded.

input: نفس اجتماع سبب تفریق نفوس موهومه است.
output: The mere act of your gathering together is enough to scatter the forces of these vain and worthless people.

input: نزاع و جدال شأن درنده‌های ارض.
output: Strife and conflict befit the beasts of the wild.

input: بیاری باری شمشیرهای برندهٴ حزب بابی بگفتار نیک و کردار پسندیده بغلاف راجع.
output: It was through the grace of God and with the aid of seemly words and praiseworthy deeds that the unsheathed swords of the Bábí community were returned to their scabbards.

input: لازال اخیار بگفتار حدائق وجود را تصرّف نمودند.
output: Indeed through the power of good words, the righteous have always succeeded in winning command over the meads of the hearts of men.

input: بگو ای دوستان.
output: Say, O ye loved ones.

input: حکمت را از دست مدهید.
output: Do not forsake prudence.

input: نصائح قلم اعلی را بگوش هوش بشنوید عموم اهل عالم باید از ضرّ دست و زبان شما آسوده باشند.
output: Incline your hearts to the counsels given by the Most Exalted Pen and beware lest your hands or tongues cause harm unto anyone among mankind.

input: در کتاب اقدس در ذکر ارض طاء نازل شده آنچه که سبب انتباه عالمیانست.
output: Referring to the land of Tá Tihrán We have revealed in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas that which will admonish mankind.

input: ظالمهای عالم حقوق امم را غصب نموده‌اند و بتمام قدرت و قوّت بمشتهیات نفوس خود مشغول بوده و هستند.
output: They that perpetrate tyranny in the world have usurped the rights of the peoples and kindreds of the earth and are sedulously pursuing their selfish inclinations.

input: از ظالم ارض یاء ظاهر شد آنچه که عیون ملأ اعلی خون گریست.
output: The tyrant of the land of Yá Yazd, committed that which hath caused the Concourse on High to shed tears of blood.

input: یا ایّها الشّارب رحیق بیانی و النّاظر الی افق ظهوری.
output: O thou who hast quaffed from the wine of Mine utterance and hast fixed thy gaze upon the horizon of My Revelation.

input: آیا چه شده که اهل ایران مع اسبقیّتشان در علوم و فنون حال پست‌تر از جمیع احزاب عالم مشاهده میشوند.
output: How strange that the people of Persia, who were unrivalled in sciences and arts, should have sunk to the lowest level of degradation among the kindreds of the earth.

input: در این یوم مبارک منیر خود را از فیوضات فیّاض محروم منمائید.
output: In this blessed, this glorious Day, deprive not yourselves of the liberal effusions of bounty which the Lord of abounding grace hath vouchsafed unto you.

input: امروز از سحاب رحمت رحمانی امطار حکمت و بیان نازل.
output: In this Day showers of wisdom and utterance are pouring down from the clouds of divine mercy.

input: طوبی لمن انصف فی الأمر و ویل للظّالمین.
output: Well is it with them who judge His Cause with fairness, and woe betide the unjust.

input: امروز هر آگاهی گواهی میدهد بر اینکه بیاناتی که از قلم مظلوم نازل شده سبب اعظم است از برای ارتفاع عالم و ارتقاء امم.
output: Every man of insight will, in this day, readily admit that the counsels which the Pen of this Wronged One hath revealed constitute the supreme animating power for the advancement of the world and the exaltation of its peoples.

input: بگو ای قوم بقوّت ملکوتی بر نصرت خود قیام نمائید که شاید ارض از اصنام ظنون و اوهام که فی‌الحقیقه سبب و علّت خسارت و ذلّت عباد بیچاره‌اند پاک و طاهر گردد.
output: Arise, O people, and, by the power of God's might, resolve to gain the victory over your own selves, that haply the whole earth may be freed and sanctified from its servitude to the gods of its idle fancies—gods that have inflicted such loss upon, and are responsible for the misery of their wretched worshippers.

input: این اصنام حائلند و خلق را از علوّ و صعود.
output: These idols form the obstacle that impedeth man in his efforts to advance in the path of perfection.

input: مانع امید آنکه ید اقتدار مدد فرماید و ناس را از ذلّت کبری برهاند.
output: We cherish the hope that the Hand of divine power may lend its assistance to mankind and deliver it from its state of grievous abasement.

input: در یکی از الواح نازل یا حزب الله.
output: In one of the Tablets these words have been revealed: O people of God.

input: بخود مشغول نباشید در فکر اصلاح عالم و تهذیب امم باشید.
output: Do not busy yourselves in your own concerns. let your thoughts be fixed upon that which will rehabilitate the fortunes of mankind and sanctify the hearts and souls of men.

input: اصلاح عالم از اعمال طیّبهٴ طاهره و اخلاق راضیهٴ مرضیّه بوده.
output: This can best be achieved through pure and holy deeds, through a virtuous life and a goodly behavior.

input: ناصر امر اعمالست و معینش اخلاق.
output: Valiant acts will ensure the triumph of this Cause, and a saintly character will reinforce its power.

input: بتقوی تمسّک نمائید هذا ما حکم به المظلوم و اختاره المختار.
output: This, verily, is the commandment which this Wronged One hath given unto you, and the first choice of His unrestrained Will for every one of you.

input: ای دوستان.
output: O friends.

input: سزاوار آنکه در این بهار جانفزا از باران نیسان یزدانی تازه و خرّم شوید.
output: It behooveth you to refresh and revive your souls through the gracious favors which in this Divine, this soul-stirring Springtime are being showered upon you.

input: خورشید بزرگی پرتو افکنده و ابر بخشش سایه گسترده.
output: The Daystar of His great glory hath shed its radiance upon you, and the clouds of His limitless grace have overshadowed you.

input: بابهره کسی که خود را بی‌بهره نساخت و دوست را در این جامه بشناخت.
output: How high the reward of him that hath not deprived himself of so great a bounty, nor failed to recognize the beauty of his Best-Beloved in this, His new attire.

input: بگو اهریمنان در کمین‌گاهان ایستاده‌اند آگاه باشید.
output: Watch over yourselves, for the Evil One is lying in wait, ready to entrap you.

input: و بروشنائی نام بینا از تیرگیها خود را آزاد نمائید.
output: Gird yourselves against his wicked devices, and, led by the light of the name of the All-Seeing God, make your escape from the darkness that surroundeth you.

input: عالم‌بین باشید نه خودبین.
output: Let your vision be world-embracing, rather than confined to your own self.

input: اهریمنان نفوسی هستند که حائل و مانعند مابین عباد و ارتفاع و ارتقاء مقاماتشان.
output: The Evil One is he that hindereth the rise and obstructeth the spiritual progress of the children of men.

input: امروز بر کلّ لازم و واجبست تمسّک نمایند بآنچه که سبب سموّ و علوّ دولت عادله و ملّت است.
output: It is incumbent upon every man, in this Day, to hold fast unto whatsoever will promote the interests, and exalt the station, of all nations and just governments.

input: قلم اعلی در هر یک از آیات ابواب محبّت و اتّحاد باز نموده.
output: Through each and every one of the verses which the Pen of the Most High hath revealed, the doors of love and unity have been unlocked and flung open to the face of men.

input: قلنا و قولنا الحقّ عاشروا مع الأدیان کلّها بالرّوح و الرّیحان.
output: We have erewhile declared—and Our Word is the truth—: Consort with the followers of all religions in a spirit of friendliness and fellowship.

input: از این بیان آنچه سبب اجتناب و علّت اختلاف و تفریق بود از میان برخاست.
output: Whatsoever hath led the children of men to shun one another, and hath caused dissensions and divisions amongst them, hath, through the revelation of these words, been nullified and abolished.

input: و در ارتقاء وجود و ارتفاع نفوس نازل شده آنچه که باب اعظم است از برای تربیت اهل عالم.
output: From the heaven of God's Will, and for the purpose of ennobling the world of being and of elevating the minds and souls of men, hath been sent down that which is the most effective instrument for the education of the whole human race.

input: آنچه از لسان و قلم ملل اولی از قبل ظاهر فی‌الحقیقه سلطان آن در این ظهور اعظم از سماء مشیّت مالک قدم نازل.
output: The highest essence and most perfect expression of whatsoever the peoples of old have either said or written hath, through this most potent Revelation, been sent down from the heaven of the Will of the All-Possessing, the Ever-Abiding God.

input: از قبل فرموده‌اند حبّ الوطن من الایمان.
output: Of old it hath been revealed: Love of one's country is an element of the Faith of God.

input: و لسان عظمت در یوم ظهور فرموده لیس الفخر لمن یحبّ الوطن بل لمن یحبّ العالم.
output: The Tongue of Grandeur hath, however, in the day of His manifestation proclaimed: It is not his to boast who loveth his country, but it is his who loveth the world.

input: باین کلمات عالیات طیور افئده را پرواز جدید آموخت و تحدید و تقلید را از کتاب محو نمود.
output: Through the power released by these exalted words He hath lent a fresh impulse and set a new direction to the birds of men's hearts, and hath obliterated every trace of restriction and limitation from God's holy Book.

input: این مظلوم حزب الله را از فساد و نزاع منع فرمود و باعمال طیّبه و اخلاق مرضیّهٴ روحانیّه دعوت نمود.
output: This Wronged One hath forbidden the people of God to engage in contention or conflict and hath exhorted them to righteous deeds and praiseworthy character.

input: امروز جنودی که ناصر امرند اعمال و اخلاقست.
output: In this day the hosts that can ensure the victory of the Cause are those of goodly conduct and saintly character.

input: طوبی لمن تمسّک بهما و ویل للمعرضین.
output: Blessed are they who firmly adhere unto them and woe betide such as turn away therefrom.

input: شما را بادب وصیّت مینمایم و اوست در مقام اوّل سیّد اخلاق.
output: I admonish you to observe courtesy, for above all else it is the prince of virtues.

input: طوبی از برای نفسی که بنور ادب منوّر و بطراز راستی مزیّن گشت.
output: Well is it with him who is illumined with the light of courtesy and is attired with the vesture of uprightness.

input: دارای ادب دارای مقام بزرگست.
output: Whoso is endued with courtesy hath indeed attained a sublime station.

input: امید آنکه این مظلوم و کلّ بآن فائز و بآن متمسّک و بآن متشبّث و بآن ناظر باشیم.
output: It is hoped that this Wronged One and everyone else may be enabled to acquire it, hold fast unto it, observe it, and fix our gaze upon it.

input: اینست حکم محکم که از قلم اسم اعظم جاری و نازل گشته.
output: This is a binding command which hath streamed forth from the Pen of the Most Great Name.

input: امروز روز ظهور لآلی استقامتست از معدن انسانی.
output: This is the day when the gems of constancy that lie hid in the mine of men's inner selves should be made manifest.

input: یا حزب العدل.
output: O people of Justice.

input: باید بمثابهٴ نور روشن باشید و مانند نار سدره مشتعل.
output: Be as brilliant as the light and as splendid as the fire that blazed in the Burning Bush.

input: این نار محبّت احزاب مختلفه را در یک بساط جمع نماید و نار بغضا سبب و علّت تفریق و جدالست.
output: The brightness of the fire of your love will no doubt fuse and unify the contending peoples and kindreds of the earth, whilst the fierceness of the flame of enmity and hatred cannot but result in strife and ruin.

input: نسأل الله ان یحفظ عباده من شرّ اعدائه.
output: We beseech God that He may shield His creatures from the evil designs of His enemies.

input: الحمد لله حقّ جلّ جلاله بمفتاح قلم اعلی ابواب افئده و قلوب را گشوده.
output: All praise be to the one true God—exalted be His glory—inasmuch as He hath, through the Pen of the Most High, unlocked the doors of men's hearts.

input: و هر آیه‌ئی از آیات منزله بابیست مبین از برای ظهور اخلاق روحانیّه و اعمال مقدّسه.
output: Every verse which this Pen hath revealed is a bright and shining portal that discloseth the glories of a saintly and pious life, of pure and stainless deeds.

input: این ندا و این ذکر مخصوص مملکتی و یا مدینه‌ئی نبوده و نیست.
output: The summons and the message which We gave were never intended to reach or to benefit one land or one people only.

input: باید اهل عالم طرّاً بآنچه نازل شده و ظاهر گشته تمسّک نمایند.
output: Mankind in its entirety must firmly adhere to whatsoever hath been revealed and vouchsafed unto it.

input: تا بآزادی حقیقی فائز شوند.
output: Then and only then will it attain unto true liberty.

input: گیتی بانوار نیّر ظهور منوّر.
output: The whole earth is illuminated with the resplendent glory of God's Revelation.

input: چه که در سنهٴ ستّین حضرت مبشّر روح ما سواه فداه بروح جدید بشارت داد و در سنهٴ ثمانین عالم بنور جدید و روح بدیع فائز گشت.
output: In the year sixty He Who heralded the light of Divine Guidance—may all creation be a sacrifice unto Him—arose to announce a fresh revelation of the Divine Spirit, and was followed, twenty years later, by Him through Whose coming the world was made the recipient of this promised glory, this wondrous favor.

input: حال اکثر اهل بلاد مستعدّند از برای اصغاء کلمهٴ علیا که بعث و حشر کلّ بآن منوط و معلّق است.
output: Behold how the generality of mankind hath been endued with the capacity to hearken unto God's most exalted Word—the Word upon which must depend the gathering together and spiritual resurrection of all men.

input: در صحیفهٴ حمرا در سجن عکّا نازل شد آنچه که سبب سموّ عباد و عمار بلاد است.
output: Whilst in the Prison of Akká, We revealed in the Crimson Book that which is conducive to the advancement of mankind and to the reconstruction of the world.

input: از جمله این بیانات در آن از قلم مالک امکان نازل اسّ اعظم که ادارهٴ خلق بآن مربوط و منوط آنکه
output: The utterances set forth therein by the Pen of the Lord of creation include the following which constitute the fundamental principles for the administration of the affairs of men:

input: اوّل باید وزرای بیت عدل صلح اکبر را اجرا نمایند تا عالم از مصاریف باهظه فارغ و آزاد شود.
output: First: It is incumbent upon the ministers of the House of Justice to promote the Lesser Peace so that the people of the earth may be relieved from the burden of exorbitant expenditures.

input: این فقره لازم و واجب چه که محاربه و مجادله اسّ زحمت و مشقّت است.
output: This matter is imperative and absolutely essential, inasmuch as hostilities and conflict lie at the root of affliction and calamity.

input: دوم باید لغات منحصر بلغت واحده گردد و در مدارس عالم بآن تعلیم دهند.
output: Second: Languages must be reduced to one common language to be taught in all the schools of the world.

input: سوّم باید باسبابی که سبب الفت و محبّت و اتّحاد است تشبّث جویند.
output: Third: It behooveth man to adhere tenaciously unto that which will promote fellowship, kindliness and unity.

input: چهارم جمیع رجال و نساء آنچه را که از اقتراف و زراعت و امور دیگر تحصیل نمایند جزئی از آن را از برای تربیت و تعلیم اطفال نزد امینی ودیعه گذارند و باطّلاع امنای بیت عدل صرف تربیت ایشان شود.
output: Fourth: Everyone, whether man or woman, should hand over to a trusted person a portion of what he or she earneth through trade, agriculture or other occupation, for the training and education of children, to be spent for this purpose with the knowledge of the Trustees of the House of Justice.

input: پنجم توجّه کامل است در امر زراعت.
output: Fifth: Special regard must be paid to agriculture.

input: این فقره اگرچه در پنجم ذکر شد ولکن فی‌الحقیقه دارای مقام اوّلست.
output: Although it hath been mentioned in the fifth place, unquestionably it precedeth the others.

input: در ممالک خارجه این فقره بسیار ترقّی نموده و امّا در ایران الی حین امرش معوّقست.
output: Agriculture is highly developed in foreign lands, however in Persia it hath so far been grievously neglected.

output: Righteous men of learning who dedicate themselves to the guidance of others and are freed and well guarded from the promptings of a base and covetous nature are, in the sight of Him Who is the Desire of the world, stars of the heaven of true knowledge.
